buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Tenderer will submit EMD @ 2 % of the estimated bid value in rounds of ten as mentioned in the bid doc ument, or submit proper exemption documents otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. 2.An Office/Branch office of the service provider must be located in the state of the consignee i.e Delhi .Th e offer will be summarily rejected if documentary evidence is not provided with the offer/ bid. 3.The bidder shall submit an undertaking on its letterhead, duly signed and stamped, confirming acceptan ce of the Scope of Work and Special Terms and Conditions attached to the bid. Failure to submit the undert aking shall result in summary rejection of the bid. 4. The tenderers must submit a copy of PAN CARD, GST and UDYAM registration certificates duly signed by the seller; otherwise, the offer is summarily rejected. 5. The tenderer shall submit an undertaking on their official letterhead, duly signed and stamped, confirmi ng that the new vehicle(s), as per the tender specifications, shall be deployed within 15 days from the date of award of the contract. Failure to submit the undertaking shall result in summary rejection of the bid. 6. As per GCC clause 2.6.1.2 the bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 time s the advertised bid value during the last three previous financial year and the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender/bid, otherwise the offer will be summarily rejected. 7. As per GCC clause 2.6.2.1.2, each page of the copy of the documents / certificates in support of credenti als, submitted by the bidder, shall be self-attested by the bidder or authorized representative of the biddin g firm, otherwise, the offer will be liable to be rejected. 8. As per GCC clause 2.6.2.1.3, the bidder shall submit an affidavit on a stamp paper to the effect that all t he documents submitted by bidder with their bid are true otherwise, the offer will be summarily rejected. 9. Bidder will provide financial break up with detailed estimate for both dry and wet lease otherwise summ arily rejected.

10. Outstation Night charges will not be provided; if the seller quotes outstation night charges, their offer will be summarily rejected. 11.Bidder will provide on letterhead that will not claim over and above against the contract value. 12. Headquarters of the vehicle will be located at Delhi. 13. The tenderer will undertaking on their letterhead with sign and stamp for obtaining; Airport entry perm it ( AEP), Airport Driving Permit (ADP) and Airport parking at own cost otherwise offer will be summarily re jected. 14.Vehicle category and models: Vehicles shall be as specified in the GeM bid, n amely Hyundai Creta EV, Maruti Suzuki e Vitara ALPHA or equivalent with top model and, for wet lease, Tata Nexon EV or equivalent with top model . 15.Bidder's offer is summarily rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates/documents specified in t he Bid document, ATC, along with their offer. No fresh documents shall be entertained at the stage of repr esentation. . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA Rail Coach Factory payable at kapurthala . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C PFA Rail Coach Factory, kapurthala . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of PFA Rail Coach Factory payable at kapurthala . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA Rail Coach Factory payable at kapurthala . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.

9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA Rail Coach Factory,kapurthala A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
